answer: Mechanism: PUF-bound sequential-liveness gate. Each agent identity is minted only when a hardware PUF signs a service-issued ember challenge, then completes a fixed VDF delay; the signed relic is recorded in an umber append-only ledger. Duplicate PUF entropy or parallel ember answers are rejected, and each PUF gets one active identity plus rate-limited renewal. An attacker’s marginal clone needs another distinct PUF-backed device and paid compute/latency; per-identity rewards are capped below that cost, so each marginal clone is strictly negative-EV.
